title: cinematic.started
description: M12C § In-engine cinematic playback. Fires on the first tick of any cinematic the player sees (opening / between-mission / campaign-ending). `id` is the on-disk cinematic id (matches `content/cinematics/**/<id>.cinematic.ron`). `source` distinguishes the three classes per spec § Player-facing behavior. `replay=true` marks a Codex → Cinematics replay launch (no save mutation).
